increment: R-RX13 web audition of a stopped receiver trace (sonification of the +0x587 trace store; not the native receiver sound)
method: No new static recovery, provider output, original input, CLEA execution, emulation or native trace. The audition reads only contracts already ported by R-RX2 (radioReceiver.ts, radioReceiverDisplay.ts). The listing paths and SHA-256 values below are copied from RADIO-RECEIVER-MONITOR-PROVENANCE.json (not recomputed here); paths are relative to /tmp/clea-static-research unless they start with ROOT (the research root). Tests check this implementation's contract, not native equivalence.

evidence.use: reset zeroes rows 0..max and lastX (main only, at Receive start)
append only for x <= 399: rows[x] := Word(y), lastX := x
replay range 0..lastX only when not receiving and lastX != 0
title change while not receiving sets every lastX := 0
position := N and the main store reset before the profile build
row = 0x6e - Round(signal * displayGain), signal >= 0; position order (main increments before append, channels copy); finish at position N
Receive start (Paint, source refresh, timer on) and Stop (+0x42d := 1)

inferences.statement: The main's frame never stores index 0 (401 is beyond max, then each frame increments before the append), so main row 0 is the reset zero, not a sample; the audition range of the main is 1..lastX. Channels copy the main's wrapped position and store row 0, so their range is 0..lastX.
inferences.witness: ported FRAME order only; no native trace

inferences.statement: For a cached display gain g >= 0 only (+0 and -0 included): a stored Word above 110 can only be a negative row truncated to a Word (signal above the top of the display); it is played at full level and counted. Rows with Round(signal * g) in [65536k, 65536k + 110], k >= 1, alias back into 0..110 and are undetectable. A row that is not an Int32 stores null (ported append), which the audition refuses as missing-row. A negative g is refused (negative-gain); no signed waveform is modelled.

FormCreate caches sensitivity = +0x924 and displayGain (+0x565) = verticalGain * sensitivity; Vert. Gain steps (x2 or /2 within [0.125, 8]) recompute it from the same sensitivity. The sign of a receiver's display gain is therefore fixed for its life and every row of its store used a gain of that sign. A live options copy changes only the bank's options; a channel added later caches the new Gain in its own FormCreate. The audition reads the receiver's cached displayGain, never the live options.
inferences.witness: ported formCreate/stepVertical only; R-RX1 provenance, not re-listed here. No native grammar or runtime claim about which Gain values the original admits.

inferences.statement: On the ported paths a null row inside the audition range comes only from a frame whose row was not an Int32 (lastRow null): Add Channel is refused while the timer runs, Receive start zeroes the main's rows and channels fill contiguously from row 0.
inferences.witness: ported radioReceiver.ts paths only; not native evidence

webMapping.domain: cached displayGain (+0x565) >= 0; negative refused (negative-gain); zero admitted (flat 110, silence); missing or non-finite refused (invalid-trace)
notClaimed: a signed waveform model for a negative display gain
native Gain editor grammar or runtime admission of a negative Gain
waveform, sampling, timing, device, pitch or loudness equivalence
